script: My (23 year old male) girlfriend (20 year old female) gave me an ultimatum between her and my parents. I made a choice, now how do I fix things?. I was like, "Okay, it's my birthday, so I am taking my parents out for a nice dinner." I told my girlfriend, "I've got plans with my fam, but we'll still hang." She looked like a statue for a second—then her face dropped. But here's the thing… I didn't even realize how big that little detail would blow up. My girlfriend had been calling my parents "the weirdest family ever." She said their constant visits were "creepy" and "the audacity." I was like, "Bruh, they're my parents; they're not creepy." What I didn't know was that every time I said yes to them, I was silently handing her a new argument. Fast forward to Saturday. It was my birthday, my parents were on a two-hour drive, and I let them crash in my empty bedroom because hotels are a pain. I had imagined a chill night, a fancy restaurant, and us laughing. And that's when everything changed… the parents were almost at my door and my girlfriend texted me a line that made my heart drop. She gave me the ultimatum: "Cancel the parents' dinner, or I am out of your life." I said, "I am not going to choose my love over my family." She didn't even show up for dinner—just sat on her phone, sulking. But here's the thing… she was not just mad; she was breaking my heart with every text. After the dinner, she hit me with a barrage of insults. "Pathetic," she typed. "Why are you so close to them? You're a mommy's boy." She said I should cut ties with my parents and that I'd "lose everything." I was like, "I am not losing anything, I am just keeping my family." But what I didn't know was how much her words could shatter my self-esteem. If I didn't pick the right side, I'd lose my parents, my future, and my peace of mind.
